description.narrative:
Oxfam proposes to implement an integrated WASH, Gender and Protection project that addresses the current needs of the new refugees and their host communities in close collaboration with OPM, UNHCR, Nsamizi and MTI partners. The project is aims to reach out to 26,000 (Females – 15,600, Males – 10,400) and this will be building on on-going response initiatives by other players and aims to enable the refugees access basic services within the recommended Sphere and UNHCR standards while strengthening their resilience andself- reliance.
Oxfam will enhance access to safe water, dignified sanitary facilities and hygiene practices through community engagement on behavioural change among new arrivals and their neighbouring host communities in synergy with UNHCR, OPM and other partners, stakeholders and Isingiro district Health and water departments.
Water supply: Actions will target pipeline extension, installation of water storage tanks and support water quality monitoring. At least 2 km of piped water supply and distribution networks willbe extended to newly settled populations. More actions will include installation of 4 water storage tank in institutions and procure and distribution of pool testers and DPD tablets for water quality monitoring.
Sanitation: Access to safe excreta systems at community level hrough construction of gender sensitive communal latrines and bath shelters, PSNs will be supported with complete latrines that suit their level of disability, as well as procurement and distribution of latrine digging kits for latrine pit excavation as Nsamizi provide dome shaped slabs for HH latrine construction. Additionally, the project will support existing solid waste management structure through trainings and provision of PPEs and Mobile Bins for appropriate solid waste management

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project’s implementation.
